title: Business Analyst / Full-Stack Developer
bullets:
Built the SIS mobile application in Flutter and integrated it with the existing enterprise School Information System, making its core features accessible on mobile.
Designed and implemented the SIS backend API endpoints with ASP.NET Core Web API, from SQL Server stored procedures through business logic, and connected them to the Flutter frontend for data retrieval, submission, authentication and application workflows.
Implemented SIS modules for marks and academic results, examinations, personal information, timetables, attendance, events, agendas and file management.
Supported administrators, teachers, students and parents with role-based permissions and implemented branch-specific and user-specific data access, working with JWT authentication and a multi-tenant architecture.
Supported English, Arabic and French interfaces, including right-to-left layouts, and integrated Firebase Cloud Messaging for mobile notifications.
Troubleshot API integrations, improved application workflows and resolved frontend/backend data inconsistencies.
Developed the ANC Fabrics mobile app with Flutter and REST APIs, and worked on its Android deployment and iOS testing.
Contributed to the Dynasoft Technology SaaS website (dynasoft.technology) for ERP, school management and medical software solutions, with a Blazor frontend, an ASP.NET Core backend and a SQL Server database using stored procedures.
Worked closely with management and end users to understand requirements, troubleshoot issues and improve functionality.
Followed Agile workflows, collaborating through Jira, Slack and ClickUp.
technologies: C# | ASP.NET Core | ASP.NET Core Web API | SQL Server | Stored Procedures | Flutter | Dart | REST APIs | JWT Authentication | Firebase Cloud Messaging | Blazor | Jira | Slack | ClickUp
